1879064252.name: Sign of Power: Righteousness
1879064252.desc: Renders an ally immune to stuns, dazes, and other combat states.

1879073596.name: Head-butt
1879073596.desc: Allows you to smash an enemy with your head for damage.

1879094844.name: Storm Lore
1879094844.desc: A thunder-clap stuns surrounding enemies briefly, inflicting weak damage.

1879102780.name: Guile Signal
1879102780.desc: Extends Guile fellowship skill bonus to your fellowship.

1879110460.name: Rune-sign of Winter
1879110460.desc:
<rgb=#00FFDD>Affinity - Frost
Affinity skills will change their effects when you use an elemental skill (frost, fire, lightning).</rgb>

A Rune-sign will not only inspire, but infuses an ally with minor elemental powers.

1879136828.name: Improved Herald's Strike
1879136828.desc: This stronger melee attack increases the effects of healing on yourself for a short time and gives Morale to your group.  This attack will also remove Corruption.

1879139388.name: Shield Bash
1879139388.desc: After blocking an attack you can slam your shield into your opponent.

1879212092.name: Snow-jar
1879212092.desc: This looks like a budget version of a snow globe. It's basically just a handful of snow...in a jar. If you want it to snow you'll probably just have to open it and turn it upside down.

1879213884.name: A Slight Sting (Melee)
1879213884.desc: Your Fellowship strikes at Draigoch's rear left leg, reducing its ability to resist damage.

1879215036.name: Return to Gramsfoot
1879215036.desc: A map detailing the lay of the land leading to Gramsfoot.

1879218620.name: Improved Chord of My Salvation
1879218620.desc: Instantly heals your Morale, applying a small heal to nearby Fellowship members.

1879221564.name: Major Ballad
1879221564.desc: Boosts healing capability and harms your foe.\n\nBallads unlock Anthems and Codas.

1879227836.name: Ring of Lightning
1879227836.desc: Wield the power of Lightning to assault Saruman by calling down the fury of the sky in a distributed attack.

1879231420.name: Ranged Wall of Steel
1879231420.desc: A weaving throw, dealing strong direct damage.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879232700.name: Fire
1879232700.desc: Set the Ent on fire for 15 seconds

1879244860.name: Roar of the Eorlingas
1879244860.desc: You issue a loud cry drawing the heart out of the enemy, dealing damage and slightly increasing threat against the target.\n\n<rgb=#66ffff>Applies the Shout effect to you. Skill of the Eorlingas becomes Halt the Charge.</rgb>

1879245628.name: Fixation
1879245628.desc:
<rgb=#66ffff>In Rohirrim</rgb>
<rgb=#FF7700>Focusing on runes of longevity coupled with runes of inspiration the Rune-keeper ably inspires a friendly target.</rgb>

<rgb=#66ffff>In Riddermark</rgb>
<rgb=#FF7700>The chilling nature of frost is coupled with runes of longevity to impose the a bone-numbing slow to come over an enemy target.</rgb>

<rgb=#66ffff>In Red Dawn</rgb>
<rgb=#FF7700>The slow nature of a flame that consumes is coupled with runes of longevity to bring about a long slow burn on an enemy target.</rgb> This effect can stack up to three times.

1879247804.name: Recuperate
1879247804.desc: A Champion knows when they must leave the din of battle for brief respite, relying on their War-steed for safety.

1879254076.name: Jollification
1879254076.desc: The Burglar takes great joy in wreaking havoc amongst their enemies.\n\n<rgb=#ff6600>This skill is enhanced by Trick: Stratagem.</rgb>

1879302588.name: Call to Arms: Herald of Hope (Maid-at-arms)
1879302588.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Hope into battle. This banner increases the mitigations of those around it.

1879361468.name: Lantern Gourd-lurker
1879361468.desc: Brings out a lantern gourd-lurker to keep you company.

1879396924.name: Tan Wolf-dog
1879396924.desc: Brings out a friendly wolf-dog to keep you company.

1879402684.name: Elk of the Spring Wood
1879402684.desc: An Elk steed that seems to grow and thrive with the forest.

1879414972.name: Strike Towards the Sky
1879414972.desc: A powerful uppercut.\n\nKnocks the enemy into the air. Slightly.

1879420860.name: Umber Nether-hound
1879420860.desc: Summons a nether-hound to help you search caverns and other tight spaces.

1879427900.name: Gundabad Ukhrash
1879427900.desc: Summons an ukhrash to keep you company.

1879442108.name: Shire Holly Steed
1879442108.desc: This steed is dressed to celebrate the season.

1879453244.name: Sprint
1879453244.desc: Increases movement speed.\n\nGrants immunity to movement speed debuffs.

1879454268.name: Guide to Andrath
1879454268.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Andrath in Cardolan.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879476796.name: Crocodile Hatchling
1879476796.desc: Summons a crocodile hatchling to accompany you on your journeys.

1879480636.name: Fiery Desert Snake
1879480636.desc: Summons a snake to accompany you on your travels.

1879490748.name: Frostbite
1879490748.desc: Your companion cuts through their targets defences with claws like razors.

1879491516.name: Return to Maurûsh
1879491516.desc: You're able to quickly return to Ub Nishir, near Maurûsh in Urash Dâr in the Ikorbân Valley. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879526588.name: Prepare: Wisp of Acid
1879526588.desc: The wicked have learned to recover magical sustenance from the infliction of pain.

1879529532.name: Regal Grove Fawn
1879529532.desc: Summons a regal grove fawn to accompany you on your travels.
